verdict.rationale: The overview docs list "Explain this repo." as a first prompt that needs no manually selected files, unlike the @file variant. Plan mode documents that the agent explores the codebase on its own, and subagents can investigate in separate contexts and return summaries, which together support autonomous whole-repo understanding. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of how the agent maps or indexes large codebases (e.g. architecture overviews or dependency maps), and independent hands-on reports of its repo-explanation quality.
